name: com.logtolast/trading-journal
title: LogToLast Trading Journal & Playbook
description: Connect Claude or Cursor to your LogToLast futures & forex trading journal and playbook rules.

tools.name: get_trading_summary_and_playbook
tools.description: Fetches the trader's quantitative performance metrics (win rate, profit factor, net PnL, expectancy), persistent Core Memory profile, active Playbook rules, and recent Master Account executions (excluding internal consolidated/duplicate copier follower rows).

lookback_trades.description: Maximum number of recent closed executions to include in the log (1-60). Defaults to 60.

tools.name: inspect_trade_by_id
tools.description: Fetches full execution telemetry, entry/exit timestamps, commission fees, trader notes, setup tags, and Playbook compliance details for a specific Trade ID. Set include_screenshots=true only when the user explicitly asks to inspect the saved chart images.

include_screenshots.description: Attach up to 4 saved WebP chart screenshots when explicitly requested for visual analysis.
